summary: Iteration 138 (frontend-only regression for AITS Leaderboard, Rapid Fire Fold-screen daily, once-a-day greeting, RF lobby regression). Signed in ONCE as QA learner 7004186276 behind the browser-side fixtures (fake_aits, fake_board, fake_daily_done, count_sounds). 53/57 initial checks PASS; the 4 misses were all test-harness ordering issues (not product bugs) and were re-verified green in iter138_followup.py. Overall PASS for A1-A6, B, C (with one soft note on 'charge' sound on new-day re-open) and D. No horizontal overflow at 390x844 or 320x640 on /series-leaderboard, no overflow at 750x860 on /rapid/daily, victory picture 523 px wide and centered with 113.5 px L/R margins at 750, 353 px wide at 390. No pageerror seen; only the known expo-audio/pointerEvents deprecation warnings and a /auth/refresh 401 before sign-in. No POSTs left the browser for /api/jl/attempts/<id>/leaderboard or /api/rf/daily/{start,answer,finish,board}: all intercepted. No real paper was started, answered, submitted; no Misfire writes.

integration_issues.flow: Rapid Fire 'charge' greeting on new-day re-open
integration_issues.issue: After clearing rf.heard.v1 to 2000-01-01 and reloading, the 'card' sound (scene_cup) replayed on the lobby as expected, but tapping rf-all-india + rf-daily-popup-enter produced NO scene_race / scene_cup (expected one each). On first-ever open of the same session the full triplet ['scene_cup','scene_race','scene_cup'] was heard. Likely a 'charge' key path not actually using firstToday on reopen, or firstToday race with storage hydration. Please have the main agent verify in src/rapid/DailyParts.tsx / DailyScenes / sfx.ts.

action_items: Investigate once-per-day 'charge' sound on new-day re-open: after localStorage reset to 2000-01-01, the card sound plays on lobby but scene_race/scene_cup do not play on the daily-result re-open. First-time flow was fine.

On /rapid/daily-styles, clicking rf-all-india-style sometimes lands on an empty styles page (no rf-daily-style-* tiles visible) during the iter138_followup2 flow (right after sign-in -> tap style pill). Please verify navigation/data fetch; initial lobby load from sign-in works, but a direct tap to style pill occasionally renders nothing. May be a stale-fixture artifact; confirm manually.
critical_code_review_comments: sfx.ts firstToday() loads heard from storage asynchronously; if playSfx or a scene is triggered before heardLoaded resolves, the first call may see heard={} and mark 'today' regardless. Consider gating scene play on the same promise.
series-leaderboard.tsx DayBoard useBoard(a.id) key is fine; verify forgetBoard is called on retry (confirmed) - no issue.
seed_data_creation: None. All leaderboard and daily traffic intercepted in-browser via fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use iter138_aits_board_rf_daily.py as the regression entry point. Sign in happens ONCE per browser context (rate limited otherwise). Install fake_aits -> fake_board -> fake_daily_done -> count_sounds BEFORE sign-in. For A4 states, re-register fake_board state via page.unroute(regex) then fake_board(state=...) and re-enter the board (back + series-open-leaderboard again) so useBoard is fresh. On /rapid/daily, there is NO tab-rapid testID; to go back to the lobby use rf-daily-exit before reloading or navigating. Reload via location.reload() keeps the path (/rapid/daily) and the auth session; no re-login needed.
